task: Test whether completed fixed checkpoints also misclassify source-training normal and hover windows, compared with held-out source-validation normal predictions.
scope: All83051 admitted source-train normal endpoints, including21145 original-normal and61906 inactive-in-fault-case normal; compare all17740 val normal endpoints including4565 original-normal. No subsampling, new thresholds or checkpoint selection. Fixed0.5/argmax decision, existing source-train statistics, original masks/indices and case groups.
mode: model.eval and inference_mode, original GPU execution environment, no optimizer or gradient updates, no BatchNorm statistic mutation, no augmentation. Measures training-data performance in inference mode, not online minibatch training accuracy.
breakdowns: four quarters of original retained crop
crop_progress: Use previously saved causal case metadata row count, not last selected valid window and not inferred physical flight phase. No raw log reread.
validation_path_check: Recompute full34710 source-val probabilities with same512 batch layout and compare argmax to saved predictions. Require max probability difference<=1e-5 (floating kernel allowance only) and identical discrete predictions; report actual differences. Do not use any new val result to choose model/threshold.
interpretation: If train normals also fail in eval mode, cannot attribute remaining failure solely to held-out normal generalization; if train normals perform well and val normals fail, supports train-val generalization gap. Exact feature/branch/BatchNorm mechanism is not established by this test.
